gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagr: Commanding up top, Wallpoet lets the paper show through its lines and sends tall lowercase soaring. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri follows with short ascenders and a tall x-height, a plain sans that reads easily over a long page.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac is friendly and rounded, with bulb-like bowls. Wallpoet hits harder above it, bold and commanding, its lowercase rising high, so the soft body text gives the loud heading room to breathe.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syriac-east: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern reads approachably, its tall lowercase set against small caps and its curve endings kept well apart. Wallpoet is the loud one; the body font simply keeps going.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syriac-west: Stripped-back and clean. Wallpoet's bold lines let the paper show through, and Noto Sans Syriac Western carries a longer read with terminals held far from its stems, dense yet modern.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa has open curves with clear gaps, and its lowercase fills most of the height. Wallpoet adds its commanding bold weight on top, and the plain sans below keeps that loudness from crowding.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Wallpoet's lines let the paper show through between letters, a bold, commanding look with smooth bends. Noto Sans Tai Le can stay at modest size, since its strokes taper out before touching and its capitals barely step up.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with smooth bends and lowercase that rises high. Noto Sans Tai Tham sits beside it like chalk-board writing, crowded toward the capital line, with an open c that feels friendly against the heavy heading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Bold, see-through lines with high-rising lowercase make Wallpoet instantly loud, while Noto Sans Tai Viet brings short ascenders and a tall x-height. Their strongest quality is contrast.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-takri: Wallpoet commands attention with smooth bends, high lowercase, and paper showing between its letters. And Noto Sans Takri, a high-waisted sans with generously open round letters, gives that heading its strongest quality: quiet contrast.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Magnified-looking text, tall and loose. Noto Sans Tamil stops its terminals far from the stem, while bold Wallpoet above it keeps its smooth bends, so the loud heading and the open body sit comfortably together.
